qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Cenovus holds multi-decade, low-decline steam-assisted gravity drainage (SAGD) oil sands reservoirs (Christina Lake, Foster Creek) and integrated refining capacity from the Husky acquisition. However, the business is a pure price-taker exposed to global crude benchmarks (WTI, Brent), Western Canadian Select (WCS) heavy oil discounts, and refining crack spreads, with zero unilateral pricing power.
qualitative.note: Rejected at Gate 3 (Moat & Pricing Power). Cenovus is an integrated oil sands operator whose cash flows and returns are dictated by global oil benchmark prices and heavy crude differentials. Through-cycle ROIC fails the 12% moat hurdle, dropping near 0% during downturns.
qualitative.evidence: ROIC swung wildly across the cycle: dropping to near 0% in 2020 during the oil collapse, surging during the 2022 energy price spike, and moderating back to mid-single digits by 2024. Multi-cycle 10-year median ROIC sits well below 10%, confirming pure commodity price-taker status without sustainable economic rent.
